mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0 percentage points, it signals severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0% year-over-year) indicates successful monetary easing without inflationary pressure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL is below 3.0%, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above the 12-month moving average signals improving consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, HOUST above 12-month MA does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0, it signals strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases by more than 100,000, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), an increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.
